📰 UAE OFFICIAL INFORMATION

Live News

Latest available public updates from verified UAE government and police sources. Read full announcements directly on the publisher's website.

News has not been checked yet.

Official announcements

The live headlines are loaded directly from the Fujairah Police official RSS feed when the browser permits it. Fujairah Police is a police authority within the UAE Ministry of Interior system; the feed is not a nationwide MOI breaking-news feed. If updates are unavailable, use the official Ministry of Interior and UAE Government links below. An RSS item is shown with its original publication date; Yusr does not independently verify the facts in a notice.
